about: Brief 119 Part 2: cooling limited to a fixed sensible output, W, the mirror of 108_capped_spec.json. Chosen before any comparison with EnergyPlus as round figures below Engine 2's unlimited cooling peaks (cooled room middle 1,411 W; Bridgewater storey 3 20,324 W): cooled room 'tight' about 57 %, 'mild' about 78 %; Bridgewater storey 3 at 12,000 W, about 59 %. Units all convective, as EnergyPlus's ideal loads are.
gate: each limited zone against EnergyPlus: annual cooling ±10 %, hours more than 0.5 K above the cooling setpoint ±20 % or ±50 h, highest air temperature ±1 K (108's heating gate, mirrored; the brief's ±5 % was replaced before any run so that the two limits are held to one gate)
